design: V1.1 Console rail below the deck

url.dimension: ?dimension=<id> selects a dimension, exactly as today via SonarSelection; strips are the new triggers for the same state

belt.container: one glass band, radius 12, no border, no pill per item
belt.items: icon + headline with the value in mint + mono meta, divided by 1px mint hairlines (border-left on every item but the first)
belt.motion: keep NewsBelt marquee: linear loop, duration from useTickerSpeed, paused on hover
belt.reduced_motion: no animation; band becomes a hand-scrollable row with hidden scrollbar (today's behaviour)
belt.empty: no items: the band does not render (today's behaviour); never an empty shell
belt.a11y: band stays aria-hidden decorative as today; the same stories are reachable in their feeds

rail.order: taxonomy order, left to right, all seven always present
rail.strip_is: a <button>, the whole strip is the hit area, min target 44px tall
rail.hover: background lifts one step, hue border alpha rises, 0.15s; waveform amplitude unchanged
rail.selected: strip border goes solid in its hue, background takes a hue tint at 10%, its stem brightens to 80% alpha; aria-pressed=true; same panels open as selecting that dimension today
rail.roadmap: strip at 62% opacity, flat dashed waveform, hollow ticks, status ROADMAP; click routes to the dimension's roadmap view exactly as its current mark does
rail.live_pulse: on a live strip a 2px dot may travel its stem toward the deck every few seconds; off under prefers-reduced-motion
rail.keyboard: strips are in tab order left to right; visible focus ring 2px mint, offset 2; Enter/Space select; Escape clears selection if a selection exists (today's rule)
rail.touch: no hover states required on touch; selected state alone carries meaning plus the pressed label

bus.parts: feed line from deck base with a mint node dot, horizontal bus hairline fading at both ends, one stem per strip rising from the bus into the strip top
bus.selected: only the selected strip's stem brightens; the bus itself never changes

states.loading: counts unknown: strip shows a shimmer block where count and ticks sit; name and hue render immediately; never a spinner
states.ping_flow: unchanged: sending a ping swaps the whole scene (deck + rail) for the loader and results, exactly as the map is swapped today
states.error: taxonomy is static so the rail cannot fail; if the news feed fails the belt simply does not render

motion_budget.reduced_motion: waveform static, no stem pulse, no marquee
